title: A title under 60 characters.
subject: Mathematics
author: Dan McCreary
learningObjectives: Identify the files that make up a MicroSim package: main.html, a p5.js sketch file, an index.md lesson page, and metadata.json
Explain how main.html loads the p5.js library from a CDN and links the sketch file with a script tag
Modify the template's createCanvas() and canvas.parent() calls in setup() to attach a sketch to the page's main element
Design a new MicroSim by copying the template and replacing the placeholder title, description, and sketch code
